## **2. create-pantoken-app.md Generation & Publication**

**Generator script:**
[docs/scripts/stage-create-pantoken-app-skill.ts](docs/scripts/stage-create-pantoken-app-skill.ts)

```typescript
/**
 * Publish the `create-pantoken-app` skill at `/create-pantoken-app.md`, so any agent CLI's own
 * fetch tool can pull down the exact same instructions a local Claude install reads from
 * `.claude/skills/create-pantoken-app/SKILL.md` (via `npx @pantoken/ai init`) — no install step
 * required. `public/` is served verbatim by VitePress (see `robots.txt`), so this is a plain copy
 * of the one canonical source, run before `vitepress dev`/`build`.
 */
import { copyFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";

const docsRoot = join(import.meta.dirname, "..");
const source = join(docsRoot, "../ai/pantoken-ai/skills/create-pantoken-app/SKILL.md");
const publicDir = join(docsRoot, "public");

mkdirSync(publicDir, { recursive: true });
copyFileSync(source, join(publicDir, "create-pantoken-app.md"));

console.log("✓ staged create-pantoken-app skill to public/create-pantoken-app.md");
```

**Source file:** [ai/pantoken-ai/skills/create-pantoken-app/SKILL.md](ai/pantoken-ai/skills/create-pantoken-app/SKILL.md) — This is the 300+ line skill that scaffolds projects and adds pantoken

**Published to:** [docs/public/create-pantoken-app.md](docs/public/create-pantoken-app.md) (VitePress serves `public/` verbatim)

Works the same way for Gemini CLI, Cursor CLI, OpenAI Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Amazon Q
Developer CLI — swap `claude` for `gemini`, `agent`, `codex`, `copilot -p`, or `q chat`.
```

```

## **7. Deployment: GitHub Pages (Not Cloudflare/Vercel)**

**Deployment platform:** GitHub Pages

**Key workflow files:**
- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L654) — Lines 654-656: Builds docs as part of CI, uploads `docs-site` artifact
- [.github/workflows/docs.yml](/.github/workflows/docs.yml) — Complete workflow:

- name: Write custom domain file
  if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
  run: echo "pantoken.app" > docs/.vitepress/dist/CNAME

- name: Upload Pages artifact
  uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5

- name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

2. Deploy workflow either downloads pre-built artifact or rebuilds on manual dispatch
